summary: Invesco Mortgage Capital filed an 8-K reporting preliminary Q3 2026 financial data as of September 30, 2026 and declaring a monthly common dividend of $0.12 per share for October 2026, payable to holders of record. The filing updates book value, portfolio composition, liquidity, repurchase agreements and leverage; no strategic transaction, stake, price or premium is stated. Management gave no board recommendation beyond the routine dividend declaration. This is a routine REIT current report (Items 2.02, 7.01, 8.01) with an earnings-adjacent update, not a special situation. Watch monthly book value and discount-to-NAV for capital-raising or buyback signals.
